# Test Fixtures

This directory contains test documents used for testing the document processing pipeline.

## Files

- **test-pdf.txt**: Sample text document for testing PDF processing capabilities and text extraction
- **test-upload.txt**: Sample document for testing frontend integration and document upload functionality

## Usage

These files can be used in unit tests and integration tests to verify:
- Document upload functionality
- Text extraction and processing
- Chunking and tokenization
- Search indexing
- End-to-end document processing pipeline

## Adding New Test Files

When adding new test documents:
1. Use descriptive filenames that indicate their purpose
2. Keep file sizes small for fast test execution
3. Include various file types (txt, pdf, docx, etc.) to test different processors
4. Document the purpose of each file in this README
